details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:190-288 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Isolation helper state is assigned without local declarations, so it persists in the caller shell after the function returns.
  WHY: Subsequent caller logic can observe stale or overwritten isolation state; severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated this NIT, while the other reviewers rated it BLOCKER, so the highest severity is used.
- tests/test_ai_engine.py:444-450 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The regression test does not assert that isolation helper state is absent from the caller shell after `claude_run` returns.
  WHY: The test can pass without detecting leaked isolation state.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:340 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The reaper can leave a polling subprocess running until the parent shell exits, accumulating one reaper per read-profile call in a shell that stays alive.
  WHY: The reaper polls the parent PID every second, and the fallback path does not stop it when the function returns.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs"
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated mount construction
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/ai_engine.sh lines 303-306 mount the full checkout and configured extra read directories read-only without a per-file allowlist; README.md lines 2032-2034 documents that the full checkout remains mounted and there is no per-file read allowlist; Git configuration masking does not cover other secret-bearing files in the mounted checkout.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:285-288 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The five isolation helper state variables are assigned without local declarations and persist in the caller shell after `_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated` returns.
  WHY: Subsequent isolation helper calls or other caller code can observe stale values from the prior run.
- tests/test_ai_engine.py:444-450 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_read_isolation_missing_docker_falls_back` lacks the shell loop and assertion checking that isolation state does not leak.
  WHY: The test passes without verifying that isolation state does not persist in the caller shell.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs" (issue #6236, Recommendation section)
  Expected change site: `scripts/ai_engine.sh` `_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated` mount construction (line 303: full-checkout readonly bind mount)
  Evidence of absence: The read-profile container still bind-mounts the full checkout (`mounts=(--mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly")` at line 303) and configured extra read directories (lines 304-306). README lines 2032-2034 state "The read-profile container still mounts the full checkout and any configured extra read directories; do not place credentials or other secrets in those paths. There is no per-file read allowlist yet." The review-blocked judge (PR comment entry 8) classified this as MAJOR with "needs separate assessment after the credential leak is closed." The autofix editor deferred this across 5 rounds. Git config credential masking covers `.git/config` secrets but not other secret-bearing files in the checkout.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs" (from issue #6236 Recommendation: "Keep pool tokens outside the model process's filesystem and user identity; supply model authentication through a host-side relay and restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs.")
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh in _ai_engine_claude_run_isolated (mounts construction, lines 305-309)
  Evidence of absence: The container bind-mounts the entire ${workdir} and all entries in AI_ENGINE_ISOLATION_PATHS read-only via --mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly" without restricting filesystem access to non-secret audit inputs. README.md lines 2032-2034 explicitly documents this gap: "The read-profile container still mounts the full checkout and any configured extra read directories; do not place credentials or other secrets in those paths. There is no per-file read allowlist yet." While Git configuration files are masked, any other sensitive or credential-bearing files present in the mounted checkout remain readable by the model process.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:283-288 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The five isolation helper state variables lack local declarations and remain in the calling shell's scope after `_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated` returns.
  WHY: Subsequent caller logic can observe stale state, and non-empty stale arrays can corrupt mount construction or affect credential-mask mounts.
- tests/test_ai_engine.py:444-450 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_read_isolation_missing_docker_falls_back` lacks the regression assertion that checks for leaked isolation variables.
  WHY: A regression that reintroduces global assignments will not be caught by CI.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:340 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The reaper polls the parent PID until it exits, and the fallback path does not stop the reaper when the function returns.
  WHY: A shell that remains alive across multiple read-profile calls can accumulate reaper subprocesses.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Keep pool tokens outside the model process's filesystem and user identity; supply model authentication through a host-side relay and restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs." (Issue #6236 recommendation.)
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh `_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated` mount construction at scripts/ai_engine.sh:303-307; any future per-file or per-directory read allowlist that replaces the full-checkout bind mount.
  Evidence of absence: scripts/ai_engine.sh:303 mounts `${workdir}` (the full checkout) readonly; scripts/ai_engine.sh:304-306 bind-mounts every directory in `${AI_ENGINE_ISOLATED_READ_PATHS[@]}` (capped at eight) readonly; README.md:2032-2034 documents the gap as a known limitation ("The read-profile container still mounts the full checkout and any configured extra read directories; do not place credentials or other secrets in those paths. There is no per-file read allowlist yet."). The `_ai_engine_git_mask_configs` helper only sanitizes `.git/config`, `.git/config.worktree`, and `.git/common/config` (scripts/ai_engine.sh:255-278) — it does not strip embedded credentials from `.git/config` URLs (`https://user:password@host/...`), does not touch `.npmrc`, `.netrc`, `.env`, `~/.ssh/`, `.aws/credentials`, `.docker/config.json`, or any other secret-bearing file the model can read inside the bind-mounted checkout. Three reviewers (`minimax_minimax-m3`, `openai/gpt-6-luna`, `z-ai_glm-5_2`) flagged this independently; the review-blocked judge (PR comment 5987771922) classified it as MAJOR and said "the broader scope needs separate assessment after the credential leak is closed"; the autofix editor has marked it TASK_GAP_DEFERRED across the last four autofix rounds. The first two parts of the recommendation (pool tokens outside the container, host-side relay) are implemented; the third (restrict reads to non-secret inputs) is not.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  WHY: Callers that source `ai_engine.sh` and invoke Claude in the same shell retain or have their `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATION_*` variables overwritten with state from the completed run.

  Evidence of absence: Lines 303-305 mount the entire `${workdir}` and every configured `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATED_READ_PATHS` directory read-only, without a per-file restriction to non-secret inputs. `README.md` lines 2032-2034 explicitly documents that the full checkout remains mounted and there is no per-file read allowlist.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR

=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

- tests/test_ai_engine.py:447 | severity=critical | confidence=5

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs" (issue #6236, Recommendation paragraph)
  Expected change site: `scripts/ai_engine.sh` `_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated` mount construction (line 303: `mounts=(--mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly")`)
  Evidence of absence: The read-profile container still bind-mounts the full checkout and all configured extra read directories with no per-file allowlist. `README.md:2032-2034` explicitly documents this gap: "The read-profile container still mounts the full checkout and any configured extra read directories; do not place credentials or other secrets in those paths. There is no per-file read allowlist yet." Git config credential masking (lines 241-281) addresses `.git/config` secrets but not other secret-bearing files in the checkout (`.env`, `.npmrc`, API keys in source files, etc.). The editor has deferred this across 4+ autofix rounds citing the need for a trusted per-role input inventory that preserves Git-history and cross-file access. The review-blocked judge (PR comment entry[8]) classified this as MAJOR and stated "that broader scope needs separate assessment after the credential leak is closed." Parts 1 (pool tokens outside container) and 2 (host-side relay) of the recommendation are implemented; part 3 (restrict reads to non-secret audit inputs) is not.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
